name: Velanir Participation Gate
description: Decides whether a digital coworker should respond in group and channel conversations before the main agent runs.

progressText.default: Still working on this — I’ll send the result when it’s complete.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: shadow logs decisions without suppressing replies; enforce suppresses skipped group/channel turns.

classifier.provider.label: Classifier Provider
classifier.provider.help: Provider used for the lightweight binary participation decision.

classifier.model.label: Classifier Model
classifier.model.help: Model used for the lightweight binary participation decision. Platform-rendered configs use the coworker's configured OpenClaw model unless explicitly overridden.

classifier.authProfileId.label: Classifier Auth Profile
classifier.authProfileId.help: Optional OpenClaw auth profile id for the classifier model.

classifier.timeoutMs.label: Classifier Timeout
classifier.timeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for the classifier before failing open.

classifier.maxOutputTokens.label: Classifier Output Tokens
classifier.maxOutputTokens.help: Maximum classifier response tokens. This limits output only, not input context.

classifier.threshold.label: Classifier Threshold
classifier.threshold.help: Minimum score required for the coworker to participate in enforce mode.

context.source.label: Context Source
context.source.help: platform for production roster data; static for local development and tests.

context.maxMessages.label: Recent Messages
context.maxMessages.help: Number of recent group/channel messages included in classifier context.

context.refreshMs.label: Context Refresh
context.refreshMs.help: Cache duration for platform participation context.

platform.authMode.label: Platform Auth Mode
platform.authMode.help: runtime uses the scoped runtime identity token flow. static-token is local/prototype only.

platform.token.label: Platform Token
platform.token.help: Prototype-only static bearer token. Used only when platform.authMode is static-token.

logging.includeContent.label: Log Message Content
logging.includeContent.help: Default off. Enable only for controlled debugging.

logging.classifierDebug.label: Log Classifier Debug
logging.classifierDebug.help: Default off. Emits structured classifier diagnostics; exact prompt/input/output still requires includeContent.

delivery.mode.label: Delivery Mode
delivery.mode.help: coalesce withholds tool and progress narration for inbound turns and emits one final answer; passthrough preserves OpenClaw delivery.

delivery.quietWindowMs.label: Delivery Quiet Window
delivery.quietWindowMs.help: Milliseconds to keep an inbound turn silent before one bounded progress update may be delivered.

delivery.maxProgressMessages.label: Maximum Progress Messages
delivery.maxProgressMessages.help: Maximum user-visible progress messages per inbound turn. Supported values are 0 or 1.

delivery.progressText.label: Progress Message
delivery.progressText.help: Generic text used for the single long-task progress update; model-authored tool narration is never exposed.

delivery.turnTtlMs.label: Delivery Turn TTL
delivery.turnTtlMs.help: Maximum lifetime for per-session delivery state and duplicate-final protection.
